title: Indexed-bond settlement and a funding boundary

user_message: Reconcile the real quote to settlement cash and calculate a worst-scenario funded entry boundary. All packet facts are synthetic. Use only sources released so far; cutoffs are inclusive unless explicitly stated otherwise. Recompute from the authored inputs, retaining every unamended constraint. Return the declared outputs and the supporting packet IDs; do not infer market probabilities or unstated permissions.

sources.text: Synthetic packet: The original settlement record identifies the lagged pair110 and112, not the more recent current-month index114. Terminal index ratios are explicit stress assumptions.

Synthetic governing terms: The two supplied index levels are the only permissible lagged settlement observations; weight applies to the second level. No current-month or future release may replace them. All price/cash outputs are per100 original principal. Annual coupon rate is not relevant here: coupon is the stated full payment fraction due at maturity. Principal has a par deflation floor; coupon does not. Finance the nominal dirty invoice at simple ACT/360 over days; there are no intervening cash flows.

outputs.name: settlement_index_ratio
outputs.description: Interpolated lagged reference index divided by base index.

outputs.name: nominal_dirty_invoice
outputs.description: Real clean price plus real accrued, multiplied by settlement index ratio.

outputs.name: scenario_maturity_cash
outputs.description: Floored principal plus unfloored indexed coupon for each terminal scenario.

outputs.name: worst_financed_profit
outputs.description: Minimum maturity cash less financed invoice.

outputs.name: maximum_clean_real_entry
outputs.description: Largest clean real entry simultaneously meeting zero worst financed loss and the facility limit.

outputs.name: entry_fundable_and_nonloss
outputs.description: Whether current quote meets both constraints.
